x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, issue #1396. Publishing an agenda used to set the meeting lifecycle to `opened`, the in-session state LiveDecisionService checks, and revising set it back to `scheduled` even while the meeting was running. Agenda publication now has its own fields, and every published version keeps a snapshot so the agenda members were sent stays readable after a change.

agendaPublishedAt.title: Agenda published at
agendaPublishedAt.description: When the current version of the agenda was published or last changed after publication.
agendaPublishedAt.x-notes: Set by AgendaService::publishAgenda() and notifyAgendaChanged(). Empty until the agenda is published for the first time; never the meeting lifecycle.

agendaVersion.title: Agenda version
agendaVersion.description: The number of the published agenda version members last received.
agendaVersion.x-notes: 1 on the first publication, one higher on every republish and on every change to a published agenda.

agendaUnderRevision.title: Agenda under revision
agendaUnderRevision.description: Whether the published agenda has been opened for revision and a new version is being prepared.
agendaUnderRevision.x-notes: Set by AgendaService::reviseAgenda(), cleared by the next publishAgenda(). While it is set, item edits send no notice: the republish is the notice.

agendaVersions.title: Agenda versions
agendaVersions.description: Every published version of the agenda, with the items it held.
agendaVersions.x-notes: Append-only snapshots written by AgendaService: version, publishedAt and items (id, title, orderNumber).
